headline: SSP Group Expands Hong Kong Airport Catering Services
summary: London-listed SSP Group is expanding its dining footprint at Hong Kong International Airport, soft-launching a quick-service location of the popular Yung Kee restaurant.
why: Concession expansion at major transport hubs provides steady passenger-driven revenue streams for travel-catering operators.

impacts.name: SSP Group
impacts.why: Expansion into high-traffic airport hubs affects the company's operational growth.
